## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

List the commands and results. Include failures, skipped checks, and manual
test platforms where relevant.

## UI changes

Attach a real screenshot or recording for visible changes. Remove this
section if the pull request does not change the interface.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors or build output.
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration requirements are described, if any.
- [ ] No credentials, identity files, or private diagnostic data are included.
